name: hyper_rear
source: Fictional performance tyre using existing passenger-car Magic Formula coefficients. Authored dimensions match the art; reference load equals the 1500 kg 42/58 static corner load. Friction scales 1.15, vertical stiffness 260/300 kN/m; not a measured tyre fit. Rolling resistance (2026-10-06, tyre crr work): qsy1/qsy3/qsy4 are now DERIVED from the rolling_resistance anchor block - crr = crr_base*(1 + A*(v/V_r) + B*(v/V_r)^4) with crr(0.8 V_r) = 1.5 crr_base and crr(V_r) = 2.0 crr_base [AS: the 1.5/2.0 rise anchors sit between the Gillespie and Wong passenger-tyre forms, neither re-checked against a readable source], rated speed V_r [AS] fictional hypercar tyre rated 500 km/h (above the ISO 4000-1 / ETRTO Y = 300 km/h and (Y) > 300 symbols, which stop there); replaces the raw qsy4 0.0002*(v/16.7)^4 (tractor 0.0003*(v/8.3)^4) which cost 30x the base at 370 km/h on the hypercar.
